items.title: NRG Energy (NRG) Strikes $4 Billion Plant Deal And Lifts Dividend 8%
items.summary: NRG Energy (NYSE:NRG) agreed to sell six natural gas power plants totaling 4.9 GW to LS Power for US$4b in cash. The assets involved are gas fired facilities in key US markets, with closing targeted for the second quarter of 2027 pending approvals. NRG plans to use the proceeds for US$1b in debt reduction, US$1b in share repurchases, and an 8% dividend increase. items.title: NRG Soars 10% on $4 Billion Gas Plant Sale and $3 Billion Buyback Plan: “Unlocking Substantial Value”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysNRG Energy jumped 10% after agreeing to sell six gas plants to LS Power for $4 billion and raising its 2026-27 buyback plan to $3 billion. Buying back a stock this cheap is a smart use of the cash, though half goes to debt.
